email_body:
Beste,

Met veel enthousiasme reageer ik op de vacature voor Administratief Bediende Logistiek & Webshop bij Unique Mortsel. Uw oproep voor een gevarieerd takenpakket en een dynamische omgeving sluit naadloos aan bij mijn ervaring en motivatie.

In mijn huidige rol als Junior Digital Marketer bij Episto combineer ik logistiek denken met digitale vaardigheden: ik beheer websites, verwerk content en optimaliseer processen. Daarvoor werkte ik bij Katoen Natie in een hoogvolume magazijnomgeving, waar ik nauwkeurigheid en efficiëntie leerde in een snel tempo. Deze combinatie van logistieke ervaring en webbeheer maakt mij geschikt voor het verwerken van verkooporders, het beheren van webshops en het ondersteunen van de aankoopafdeling.

Ik spreek vloeiend Nederlands (B1, in opleiding) en werk gestructureerd, ook onder druk. Ik ben flexibel, leergierig en klaar om mijn steentje bij te dragen in uw team.

Graag licht ik mijn motivatie toe in een gesprek.

Met vriendelijke groet,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok

--- English version ---

Dear,

I am very enthusiastic to apply for the position of Administrative Clerk Logistics & Webshop at Unique Mortsel. Your call for a varied task package and a dynamic environment aligns perfectly with my experience and motivation.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I combine logistical thinking with digital skills: I manage websites, process content, and optimize processes. Previously, I worked at Katoen Natie in a high-volume warehouse environment, where I learned accuracy and efficiency in a fast pace. This combination of logistics experience and web management makes me suitable for processing sales orders, managing webshops, and supporting the purchasing department.

I speak Dutch fluently (B1, in training) and work in a structured manner, even under pressure. I am flexible, eager to learn, and ready to contribute to your team.

I would be happy to explain my motivation in an interview.

Kind regards,

Baver Ok

tailored_cv:
Baver Ok
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

PROFILE
Junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in logistics, warehouse operations, and web management. At Katoen Natie, I maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume logistics environment. At Episto, I manage client websites, process orders, and support sales with administrative tasks. On my own project (mirook.com), I handle webshop-like content management and order processing. Comfortable in dynamic, fast-paced settings; quick to learn new tools. Dutch B1 (actively improving), English professional, Turkish native.

CORE SKILLS
- Logistics & order processing: order fulfillment, packing, shipping, receiving, inventory tracking
- Webshop & content management: WordPress, Elementor, product updates, social media integration
- Administrative support: sales support, pricing inquiries, supplier communication, document management
- Languages: Dutch (B1, improving), English (professional), Turkish (native)
- Tools: Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console

EXPERIENCE

Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Manage client websites: content uploads, page updates, and order processing
- Support sales team with administrative tasks: inquiries, documentation, and coordination
- Track performance with analytics tools to guide decisions

Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment
- Handled order picking, packing, and shipping

Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

PROJECTS

mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) with full content management and social media integration
- Implemented structured data and technical audits to improve visibility

EDUCATION
- Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp — Coursework in Applied Computer Science (2022–2025)
- Celal Bayar University, Türkiye — Coursework in Computer Science (2012–2016)
- Diyarbakır Anatolian High School, Türkiye — High School Diploma (2012)

REFERENCES
Available on request.
